video_title: LeBron Signs with Sixers!!! BEST Starting 5 in NBA?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on LeBron James joining the Philadelphia 76ers roster
quotes.excerpt: I think this is the best possible chance for him to compete for a championship.
quotes.quote: I think this is the best possible chance for him to compete for a championship. I think it's the best roster, the best starting five that he completes when you look at Tyrese Maxey and Jalen Brown alongside Joel Embiid. Obviously, it always comes down to health with Joel. We're always going to talk about his health. We're always going to talk about LeBron's age, but there's always going to be two star-level players on the floor at the same time throughout the 48-minute game.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on LeBron James' fit with the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I think this was a strictly basketball decision as far as fit, his opportunity to win another championship.
quotes.quote: I think this was a strictly basketball decision as far as fit, his opportunity to win another championship, compete in his last couple years in the league. I think he checked the boxes with the decision he ended up making. I think Philly was the perfect team for everything he's looking for. Maybe outside of Minnesota, I thought he would have been a really good fit there as well, but I think with this decision, I think he can teach this group how to win.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the development of Tyrese Maxey and Jalen Brown
quotes.excerpt: He can help Embiid elevate to that next level, Maxey elevate, Jalen Brown is coming along as a young guy.
quotes.quote: He can help Embiid elevate to that next level, Maxey elevate, Jalen Brown is coming along as a young guy in this league. He's getting a whirlwind of experience coming into his second year. You got LeBaron for long as well who kind of got lost in the news with LeBron signing, but he was their prized draft pick this year. I like what Philly has done overall when it came to this off-season.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on LeBron James' versatility and role with the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: He's a man of many hats, one of the more versatile players that we've ever seen.
quotes.quote: He's a man of many hats, one of the more versatile players that we've ever seen. At this point of his career, this decision was strictly about winning and competing for a championship and just improving this insane legacy that he's already created. Some nights he's going to be the guy, he's going to have 30-plus points. Some nights you're going to see him have a Draymond stat line where he's got 10, 8, and 7 and they win, and everyone eats and everyone's happy.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the 76ers' roster construction and bench depth
quotes.excerpt: They did a great job of constructing the starting five and bench pieces to carry them through.
quotes.quote: They did a great job of constructing the starting five and bench pieces to carry them through that regular season. They have youth on their side as far as what they did in the draft. They signed Anthony Simons, you have Maxey as your starter who's coming off his All-Star years and you obviously have a champion in the Finals MVP in Jalen Brown. So you have more than enough to carry you through that regular season.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the 76ers' front office strategy regarding Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: I am not rushing Joel Embiid, I am putting him on a minute restriction.
quotes.quote: If I'm the front office of the Sixers, I'm not rushing Joel Embiid, I am putting him on a minute restriction. I am making sure that this roster and this team is complete come playoff times. I don't care if that's 25 minutes a night, I don't care if that's him playing 40 games. I don't care because this team whole and this team on paper is a contending roster.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the 76ers' star-studded rotation
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brown I think is going to be the head of the snake.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brown I think is going to be the head of the snake, but then Tyrese Maxey just put up an insane career year and VJ Ed comes obviously on the rise. They have a former MVP in Joel Embiid who when he's healthy is one of the most dominant players in the league. I don't think there's a right answer for that. I think any night it could be someone else differently.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the 76ers' standing in the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks, the Champs, I think starting off, if we're doing preseason rankings, I'd put them number one.
quotes.quote: The Knicks, the Champs, I think starting off, if we're doing preseason rankings, I'd put them number one. Toronto Raptors I think got better getting Kawhi Leonard, but it's a matter of health with him. On paper they're right there. I love the starting five. I think when healthy, I think this is the best starting five possibly in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the 76ers' talent level and LeBron James' impact
quotes.excerpt: I think this is the most talented roster by far.
quotes.quote: I think this is the most talented roster by far. You also have to consider where he is financially in his career for this to be even a possible thing. It's hard to even compare this team to any of his past situations because he's one of the main guys making the most money on the team. LeBron going to this team, he's the addition that also raised the level of the team but at a minimum cost.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the 76ers' star power
quotes.excerpt: You have a regular season MVP, a Finals MVP and an under-25 All-Star as your point guard.
quotes.quote: You have a regular season MVP, a Finals MVP and an under-25 All-Star as your point guard. I think this is a great situation.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the 76ers' front office and Nick Nurse
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey's agent is Rich Paul. The president of basketball operations is Mike Gansey.
quotes.quote: Once he made the decision to, I was like, obviously it was Philly. They're the best team. Tyrese Maxey's agent is Rich Paul. The president of basketball operations is Mike Gansey who played high school basketball I think with or against Mav Carter. It makes the most sense with this situation. He believes in this roster, he believes in this team and he obviously has the utmost respect for Nick Nurse to be able to finish possibly my career with this team.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the importance of team chemistry in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think that's one of the things that gets overlooked in today's game, chemistry, camaraderie.
quotes.quote: I think that's one of the things that gets overlooked in today's game, chemistry, camaraderie. Guys enjoying being teammates, playing next to one another, having similarities, even being able to relate to one another. All of those things matter. When I think about the Spurs, I think about the OKC's, I think about groups that have had years together.
